children: Revenue rises to Rs 7,518 crore in Q2 FY27, but EBITDA declines 5 per cent as operating margins contract by over 500 basis points

Waaree Energies reported a 14.7 per cent year-on-year decline in consolidated net profit to Rs 718.68 crore in the second quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 842.5 crore in the corresponding quarter last year, despite strong revenue growth.

The company's revenue from operations increased 23.9 per cent to Rs 7,518 crore in the quarter ended September 30, 2026, against Rs 6,066 crore a year earlier. However, earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) declined around 5 per cent to Rs 1,335 crore from Rs 1,406 crore in Q2 FY26. The Ebitda margin narrowed to 17.8 per cent from 23.2 per cent, a contraction of approximately 540 basis points.

The results indicate that higher revenue did not translate into improved profitability during the quarter. The decline in operating earnings, despite an increase in sales, points to pressure on margins.

On a quarter-on-quarter basis, the company's revenue declined around 5.2 per cent from Rs 7,932 crore in Q1 FY27, while net profit fell approximately 15.5 per cent from Rs 850 crore. EBITDA also declined from Rs 1,440 crore in the preceding quarter. The EBITDA margin stood at 18.2 per cent in Q1 FY27, compared with 17.8 per cent in Q2 FY27.

Separately, Waaree Energies announced the acquisition of a 100 per cent stake in Waaree Green Data Centers Private Limited, formerly Sunsantional Energy Private Limited, along with its two wholly owned subsidiaries, Aurovault Data Centers Private Limited and Sunstar Data Centers Private Limited.
The company will acquire the entities from Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited, its subsidiary, for a cash consideration of Rs 1 lakh against 10,000 equity shares with a face value of Rs 10 each.
